extracted.name: Asian Rainbow Trout
extracted.description: This Asian rainbow trout recipe features Asian-style flavors like ginger, garlic, and soy sauce — it’s a quick, easy dinner that’s ready in minutes.
ingredient_lines: 4 (6 ounce) fillets boneless, skinless rainbow trout
instruction_lines: Rub trout fillets with soy sauce. Season with sugar, salt, and pepper; set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add green onions, garlic, and ginger; cook and stir until golden brown.
Add trout fillets and cook until brown and crispy, about 3 minutes. Flip fillets over and continue cooking until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 3 minutes more.
